history.summary: A Shiva temple at Seppa, East Kameng, is documented by the Ramakrishna Mission, Lumdung: its monks and brahmacharins performed Maha Shivaratri worship (puja, vedic chanting, bhajans, prasadam) at 'Shiva Mandir, Seppa' in February 2020, February 2021 and on 1 March 2022 (the nearest Shiva temple to the RKM Lumdung centre). Beyond this, no source gives its founding date, builder, architecture or exact address, so details such as age and precise location are unconfirmed. CSV ERROR: the CSV state column holds the town name instead of the state - the temple is in Arunachal Pradesh, town Seppa. Coordinates are town-level (Seppa Post Office geocode) and approximate - verify the temple's exact location locally. Content fields are deliberately minimal rather than invented.

name: Shiva Mandir
town_description: Seppa is the headquarters town of East Kameng district in western Arunachal Pradesh, on the Kameng river in the Eastern Himalayan foothills. A remote market town serving surrounding tribal villages, it hosts the Ramakrishna Mission school at nearby Lumdung and Hindu mandirs (including a Shiva Mandir where RKM monks have observed Maha Shivaratri), with road access via NH-13.

travel.airport: Salonibari (Tezpur) Airport, Assam, about 86 km away; Donyi Polo Airport (Itanagar/Hollongi) is also used for the region.
travel.railway: Bhalukpong (about 63 km) is the nearest station in Arunachal; Rangapara North Junction (~79 km) and Harmuti Junction (~93 km) in Assam serve long-distance trains.
travel.road: Seppa lies on NH-13; reachable by road from Itanagar and Tezpur via taxis and buses.

visitor_information.best_time: October to April, avoiding the monsoon when hill roads are unreliable.
